title: GuP Music discs
description: The mod adds music discs from GuP
body:
This mod adds new music discs from Girls und Panzer. They are configured to spawn in Abandoned Mineshafts. If you encounter any issues, have suggestions, or notice that the discs are not appearing in mineshafts, please fill out the [feedback form](https://forms.gle/e6FwGd1TMpjAqfvY8)

Rarity weight and release table:
-  Kuromorimine - Erika [RE 5]
- Jatkosota - Sakkijarven Polkka [RE 10]
- Saunders - Field Artillery March [RE 10]
- Kuromrorimine - Panzerlied [RE 10]
- St. Gloriana - The British Grenadiers [RE 10]
- Oarai - Enter-Enter Mission [RE 20]
- Gakuen toiro desu! [IP]

Status legend: RE = Released | IP = In Progress
